messages:
recruiter-sam: Heads up — candidate (A. Morales) just messaged: their citywide transit strike means the 10:30 train is canceled and they may not arrive in time for the 1pm on-site loop. They can still do remote. Can we stand up the remote fallback and a loaner laptop, and also cover parking/travel stipend if needed?

lina-peopleops: Yep. Remote fallback is our default in this case. I can book a Zoom room + quiet room for them if they come in late. Can you confirm candidate needs laptop loaner and any accessibility/dietary things? @devon-it can prep a loaner for pickup. :thumbsup:

recruiter-sam: They said they prefer in-person if possible but would be ok remote. Wants a keyboard adapter (they use a compact mech keyboard) and says they have a nut allergy (pack lunch safe). Also asked about interpreter if we need to switch to earlier panel (they're bilingual but asked).

devon-it: Got it. I can have a loaner Windows laptop with USB-C + USB-A adapters and a spare compact keyboard adapter taped in the kit. Will run a remote-check with candidate at 9:15am. I’ll label it "AM-LOANER-2140" for quick pickup.

raj-hiringmgr: If they're remote for any interview, I want the coding exercise to still run smoothly — can someone host the shared screen? @jen-panel can you confirm you can screen-share the coding doc if needed?

jen-panel: Yes I can screen-share and host the collaborative doc. If we go remote, please send me the Zoom link and the paste of the short prompt. I can also cover an extra 30min if candidate is delayed.

lina-peopleops: Booking updates: reserved "Quiet Room — 3B" from 12:30–4pm (fallback space if they arrive). Zoom room "RI-Interview-2140" created. facilities-bot: updated room calendar and set digital badge hold.

facilities-bot: Room hold placed: Quiet Room 3B, 12:30-16:00. Badge pickup code emailed to candidate. Parking voucher reserved for up to $30.

devon-it: Remote-check command to candidate (I'll DM but posting here for record):
```
Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood.ai/j/8922140
Test time: 09:15 local candidate time
Things to test: mic, camera, screen-share, USB adapter
```

recruiter-sam: I'll DM candidate the badge code and Zoom link, and offer pickup window for loaner 11:30–12:00 in case they can still make some rounds. Also confirming stipend process: if they pay for transit/taxi, we can reimburse up to $50 — candidate ok with that.

lina-peopleops: Reimbursement: candidate can submit receipts to people-ops@redwood.ai with subject "Candidate Reimbursement - Morales". I'll fast-track approval. Also note nut-free lunch flag set in catering.

recruiting-bot: Reminder: Add "remote-fallback" tag to this req and note loaner issued in Greenhouse thread.

raj-hiringmgr: Thanks team. If anything changes ping me. I'll shuffle panel timings if we need to start earlier or go fully remote.

jen-panel: +1. Ready to pivot. :rocket:

lina-peopleops: Closing loop: loaner reserved (AM-LOANER-2140), quiet room hold, Zoom ready, stipend & catering noted. Sam — please confirm after you DM candidate.

recruiter-sam: Confirmed — candidate updated and accepted remote-check at 9:15. I'll post a quick status update here after the 9:15 test.
